recipes.title: Device dock
recipes.summary: A leaning desk cradle with a cable pass-through, sized to a measured device.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Gridfinity-style bin
recipes.summary: A storage bin on the 42 mm Gridfinity grid: stepped feet, stacking lip, optional dividers, scoop, label shelf and magnet pockets.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Wall hook
recipes.summary: A two-screw wall hook sized to a load, with a bending-stress estimate and countersunk screw holes fitted to your screws.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Twisted planter
recipes.summary: A polygon planter that twists as it rises, with a drainage hole that fits a standard cork or mesh plug.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Fit coupon
recipes.summary: A slot comb for calibrating internal-feature accuracy on your printer and material.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Electronics enclosure
recipes.summary: A box and screw-down lid for a circuit board: corner bosses for heat-set inserts or self-tapping screws, PCB standoffs on the board's hole pattern, USB-C and round wall cut-outs, and lid vents.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Spur gear pair
recipes.summary: Two printable involute spur gears and a plate with axle pegs at the right centre distance, with a mesh check (centre distance, backlash, contact ratio) and a tooth-strength estimate.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Control knob
recipes.summary: A knurled knob for a D-flat or round shaft: press fit or an M3 set screw in a captive nut, a pointer line and an optional skirt. Printed face down, no supports.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Hinged box
recipes.summary: A box and a lid joined by a pin hinge, printed side by side; the lid's lip is checked through its swing.
recipes.author: Form Studio

recipes.title: Cable clip
recipes.summary: A screw-down clip that snaps over a cable of measured diameter, with a fit model for the bore.
recipes.author: kaizensx
